title: [review] provisioning.py:543: Race condition in provision_no
description: Between create_br_session (line 530) and storing seed (line 548), multiple await points exist (lines 533-537). Concurrent requests can trigger _expire_sessions(), expiring this session if deadline passed. Code fails at line 544-546, but seed may already have been generated and sent encrypted. System left in inconsistent state - node has seed but BR lost session tracking.
